arguments.code:
# Step 1: Discover available phone contact relationship categories
phone_relationships=apis.phone.show_contact_relationships(access_token=phone_token)
print(phone_relationships)

# Fetch all pending received Venmo payment requests
pending_requests=[]
i=0
while True:
    res=apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token,status='pending',page_index=i)
    # res could be [] when no more pages
    if not res:
        break
    pending_requests.extend(res)
    i+=1

print('pending_total', len(pending_requests))
# Print a concise view
for pr in pending_requests:
    sender_email = pr.get('sender',{}).get('email')
    print('id', pr.get('payment_request_id'), 'amount', pr.get('amount'), 'sender_email', sender_email, 'created_at', pr.get('created_at'))

# Filter by roommates/coworkers emails (from phone contacts)
filtered=[pr for pr in pending_requests if pr.get('sender',{}).get('email') in emails]
print('filtered_pending_count', len(filtered))
print('filtered_ids', [pr.get('payment_request_id') for pr in filtered])
# Also show which emails matched
matched_sender_emails=sorted(set(pr.get('sender',{}).get('email') for pr in filtered))
print('matched_sender_emails', matched_sender_emails)
